title: The world doesn't need more Christian content. It needs more Christians who will actually teach God's Word.
paragraphs: The world doesn't need more Christian content. It needs more Christians who will actually teach God's Word.
Read that again.
Every day, millions scroll through social media.
Very few stop to open the Bible.
And even fewer are willing to lead others into God's truth.
Maybe you've thought...
"I'm not a pastor."
"I don't know enough."
"Someone else can do it better."
But what if those excuses are the very thing keeping someone from hearing the Gospel through you?
Jesus didn't command only pastors to make disciples.
He commanded all believers.

📖 NEW RELEASE:
How to Start an Online Bible Study That Reaches the World
This isn't just another book about technology or social media.
It's a biblical roadmap for believers who want to use today's digital mission field to make disciples for Christ—whether you have 5 people or 5,000.
If God has ever placed a desire in your heart to teach His Word, encourage others, or start a Bible study, this book was written for you.
Inside you'll discover:
✅ How to confidently start an online Bible study—even if you're just beginning
✅ The biblical foundation for making disciples in the digital age
✅ How to prepare lessons that are faithful to Scripture and centered on Christ
✅ Practical ways to build a healthy online community instead of just gaining followers
✅ Common mistakes that quietly destroy online ministries—and how to avoid them
✅ How to stay humble, faithful, and focused on Jesus instead of chasing popularity
✅ How ordinary believers can reach people across the world without leaving home

🔥 Most people consume Christian content.
Few people become disciple-makers.
Most people wait until they feel "qualified."
Few step out in faith and let God use them.
Most people build an audience.
Few build the Kingdom.
Which group will you belong to?
